name: Tsuma Kurazaki Sakuna no Uwaki Chousa ~Netorare Tsuma no Midara na Kahanshin Jijou~
original_name: 妻・倉崎桜菜の浮気調査 〜寝取られ妻の淫らな下半身事情〜
source:
Kurazaki Eisuke, a former detective, now runs a convenient "Subscription Detective" service. His life was picture-perfect with his wife, Sakuna, who had proposed to him during their college days, believing he was her one and only. Though childless, the couple led a content life.

Everything changed when Yoda Makoto, a university student with dreams of becoming an influencer, approached Eisuke with a request: "I think my girlfriend's cheating on me. Could you investigate?" Eisuke took on the case, but upon tracking down Yoda's mysterious girlfriend, he was shocked to discover it was none other than his own wife, Sakuna.

Eisuke couldn't comprehend why his devoted wife, who had pledged her love and future to him, would betray their vows. Despite the pain in his heart, he pressed on with the investigation, only to uncover the hidden desires lurking beneath Sakuna's seemingly prudish exterior.

[Translated and edited from Getchu]
translation:
仓崎荣介曾是一名侦探，现在经营着一项便捷的“订阅侦探”服务。他和妻子萨库纳的生活是完美的，萨库纳在大学期间向他求婚，相信他是她唯一的一个。虽然没有孩子，但这对夫妇过着幸福的生活。

当梦想成为网红的大学生尤田诚向英介提出请求时，一切都发生了变化：“我认为我女朋友在欺骗我。你能调查一下吗？”英介接手了这个案子，但在追踪尤达的神秘女友后，他惊讶地发现这不是别人，正是他自己的妻子佐久奈。

英介不明白为什么他忠诚的妻子，向他承诺了她的爱和未来，却背叛了他们的誓言。尽管内心痛苦，他还是继续调查，却发现了佐久奈看似拘谨的外表下隐藏着的欲望。

[由Getchu翻译和编辑]
